title: Homemade Buffalo Sauce
description: About 3/4 cup. Enough for 2 lb wings or 2 to 3 meals of chicken.

ingredients.note: optional: 1 tsp honey mustard or a squeeze of maple syrup to round it out

steps: Melt the butter in a microwave-safe bowl, 30 to 45 sec.
Whisk in the hot sauce and garlic powder until smooth.
Hotter: more hot sauce. Milder: more butter.
source: Joe's Meal Pack, Oct 20 to Nov 4, 2026 (built by Thrifty, now kept by Meal Plan), R8
notes: Keeps in the fridge 1 to 2 weeks. It firms up cold; microwave 15 to 20 sec and whisk.

healthy: Hot sauce has almost no calories.
not_healthy: Hot sauce is high in sodium.
